what: Unified-diff apply uses git apply in a session tmpdir that is not a git worktree
scenario_or_breakage: session-setup.sh always creates DESIGN_TMPDIR via mktemp under /tmp or the cache; git apply fails with "not a git repository" so every unified-diff tier fails in production and in the offline harness cases that use diffs
suggested_fix: Apply patches with patch(1) from the plan file directory (check + apply), or run git init in $design_tmpdir before the first git apply; document the choice in revise-plan-with-waterfall.md
